hotel_1star_semantic.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Hanoi? Hotel Prices for Hanoi, Vietnam | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_semantic.evidenceText: On the exact-city page, BudgetYourTrip reports an average 1-star hotel price of $24 based on 184 hotels and a median of $19. The page describes a one-night room-price range, states that prices are in US Dollars before taxes and fees, and identifies the star-rating class. It does not explicitly state two-person or two-adult occupancy.
hotel_1star_semantic.referencePeriod: BudgetYourTrip hotel-price analysis; page crawled today; prices are before taxes and fees and vary by season.
hotel_1star_semantic.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com/hotels Hanoi Vietnam 1-star hotel average price room for two taxes fees
hotel_1star_semantic.reason: Exact city/class, numeric nightly statistic, currency, sample, and tax exclusion were visible, but the page gives no explicit two-person occupancy. Source-default or unspecified occupancy fails this semantic experiment.
